facts.text: Park Hyatt Shenzhen is in the Futian business district of Shenzhen.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Shenzhen is a sophisticated 5-star hotel in the heart of the Futian business district.

facts.text: The guestrooms were designed by Yabu Pushelberg, with custom-made furniture and art.
facts.excerpt: Designed by renowned designer Yabu Pushelberg, all guestrooms feature unique custom-made furniture and art

facts.text: Guestrooms are on floors 36 through 44 and have floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Guestrooms span floors 36 through 44, fitted with floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: Guestrooms have a dressing zone separated by French sliding doors, a separate bathtub and rain shower, and a powder room with an automatic washlet.
facts.excerpt: distinct dressing zone separated by French sliding doors, separate bathtub and rainshower, powder room for privacy with automatic washlet

facts.text: Each room has a Nespresso coffee machine.
facts.excerpt: Each room comes with 500-thread-count linen and down duvet, 55-inch LED TV with an extensive selection of TV programs and a Nespresso coffee machine.

facts.text: The Sky View Deluxe corner rooms look out over the Shenzhen landscape and the bay.
facts.excerpt: Spacious 55 sq m room located at the corner of the building tailored with floor-to-ceiling windows and expansive skyline views, indulge in the panoramic views of the Shenzhen landscape and bay.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has its own private spa treatment room.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in complete relaxation at the private personal spa treatment room

facts.text: The Glasshouse restaurant is on the 47th floor under a glass ceiling, with 270-degree views of the Shenzhen skyline.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the 47th floor, The Glasshouse is a sun-drenched sanctuary under a magnificent glass ceiling, offering panoramic 270 degree views of the Shenzhen skyline.

facts.text: The Glasshouse serves an evening buffet featuring lobster, seafood and premium beef.
facts.excerpt: a lavish evening buffet featuring lobster, seafood, and premium beef

facts.text: Garden Pavilion serves Cantonese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Come and experience the heritage and innovation of Cantonese cuisine

facts.text: Garden Pavilion has four private dining rooms.
facts.excerpt: Garden Pavilion offers an intimate escape where nature and sunlight converge across four exclusive private dining rooms

facts.text: The Attic bar is at the top of the hotel and has an extensive collection of premium gins.
facts.excerpt: bar, located at the apex of the hotel. Blending heritage with modern inspiration in every signature cocktail, the bar boasts an extensive collection of premium gins and curated spirits.

facts.text: The Attic has a private KTV room for parties and celebrations.
facts.excerpt: the sophisticated KTV room provides the perfect setting for high-end parties and bespoke celebrations

facts.text: In the evening a live DJ plays in the Living Room.
facts.excerpt: As the sun dips below the horizon, the atmosphere shifts to a modern rhythm curated by our live DJ.

facts.text: Pool Terrace offers alfresco barbecue dining and cocktails on Level 8, next to the swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Alfresco dining with barbecue and selected cocktails on Level 8, adjacent to the Swimming Pool.

facts.text: The fitness center overlooks the indoor pool and has a steam room.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the indoor pool and stunning city views, the Fitness Center at Park Hyatt Shenzhen features a relaxing steam room

facts.text: Signature treatments at The Spa include restorative massages aimed at deep stress and muscular tension.
facts.excerpt: Signature wellness experiences include restorative massage techniques curated to alleviate deep stress and muscular tension

facts.text: Nearby places to explore include Lianhuashan Park and Shenzhen Bay Park.
facts.excerpt: including Lianhuashan Park, Shenzhen Bay Park

facts.text: Self-parking is complimentary for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Shenzhen offers complimentary self-parking for guests.

facts.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in mainland China.
facts.excerpt: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

facts.text: Service animals are welcome.
facts.excerpt: Service animals are welcome

facts.text: The hotel describes its bars and restaurants as world class.
facts.excerpt: Featuring world class bars and restaurants and unparalleled event venues

facts.text: The dining page mentions seven restaurants and bars but lists six.
facts.excerpt: An abundance of local and worldly culinary experiences awaits at seven destination restaurants and bars.

contradictions.note: p1 lists 6 restaurants and bars; p3 says seven but shows 6 results

sources.excerpt: An abundance of local and worldly culinary experiences awaits at seven destination restaurants and bars.
